title: Honor Cargo.lock in Rust CI
why: A CI command that permits dependency re-resolution can build code different from the reviewed lockfile.
suggestion: Pass --locked or --frozen to direct Cargo build, check, test, and Clippy commands.
limitations: Only direct commands in checked-in GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure Pipelines, Jenkins, and SourceHut manifests are inspected; SourceHut paths are limited to root .build.yml and direct .builds/*.yml or .builds/*.yaml files.
Commands hidden behind scripts, reusable workflows, aliases, or nonstandard shell wrappers are not resolved.

SourceHut evidence comes only from direct commands in tasks script scalars, not task names, packages, environment values, comments, or descriptions; YAML aliases and shell expansion or multiline command reconstruction are not resolved.
